Method of Attack: Encrypts victim files using AES encryption with 11 public RSA-1024 keys to encrypt the AES key
Drops ransom note _HELP_INSTRUCTION.TXT with contact emails for ransom payment
Stops Windows services (wscsvc, WinDefend, wuauserv, BITS, ERSvc, WerSvc)
Disables Windows recovery and boot status policy via bcdedit commands
Deletes shadow copies using vssadmin.exe to prevent recovery
Discoverer: Unspecified researcher or organization reporting in article
Indicators of Compromise: Executed commands: sc stop wscsvc, sc stop WinDefend, sc stop wuauserv, sc stop BITS, sc stop ERSvc, sc stop WerSvc, cmd.exe /C bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled No, cmd.exe /C bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures, vssadmin.exe Delete Shadows /All /Quiet
